issues.problem: pt-toki rule and explain said the dictionary form before とき means the clause is 'still ahead'; that is wrong for durative and stative verbs (歩くとき, いるとき = while/at the time). The correct notion is 'not yet complete'.
issues.action: Rewrote rule as 'not yet complete (still ahead or under way)' and added the stative-verb case to explain.

issues.problem: pt-toki explain claimed adjectives and nouns have no tense choice before とき; past forms (子供だったとき, 若かったとき) are normal.
issues.action: Changed to 'usually stay non-past' and noted 子供だったとき.

issues.problem: pt-toki contrast with たら implied たら cannot be used for past facts (it can: discovery/chance-event たら).
issues.action: Rewrote note: たら makes the main clause depend on X; とき only names the moment.

issues.problem: pt-maeni contrast said とき places events at the same time or overlapping, which contradicts the pt-toki teaching that 行くとき / 行ったとき are before/after; pt-tabini contrast described 最中に as 'its busiest point' (inaccurate: it means while in full swing).
